proof_summary: Generalized Wolstenholme identities make the reciprocal and reciprocal-square terms vanish in the degree-two expansion of each block of residues prime to \(p\), so every length-\(p^r\) block has the same product modulo \(p^{3r}\); splitting each factorial into its \(p\)-divisible and prime-to-\(p\) parts then proves the even case by cancellation. For odd indices, the half-integer gamma factors are rewritten using half-factorial formulas, and reflection/doubling of the lower half of the reduced residues gives a telescoping factor \(4^{\varphi(p^r)}\) that exactly cancels the additional power of \(4\).
